title: RBI: never share card, PIN, OTP or password
text: Customers should never share card numbers, PIN, CVV, OTP or passwords with anyone. Banks and the RBI do not ask for these details through calls, SMS, emails or links. Report fraud to your bank at once.
keywords: bank account otp pin cvv password card blocked kyc ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಒಟಿಪಿ ಖಾತೆ

title: UIDAI: protect Aadhaar details
text: Aadhaar details and OTPs should be shared only with trusted, authorised services. Verify any Aadhaar-related request on the official UIDAI website.
keywords: aadhaar aadhar verification uid ಆಧಾರ್ आधार

title: PIB: check government benefit claims on official channels
org: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
text: Government schemes and benefits are announced through official government websites and Press Information Bureau releases. Check any message offering money, jobs or benefits to citizens against these official channels before acting.
keywords: government scheme every citizen rupees reward free money subsidy ಸರ್ಕಾರ

title: Report online financial fraud
text: Victims of online financial fraud can report on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or call the national helpline 1930 as soon as possible.
keywords: report fraud scam helpline phishing cheated lost money

title: CERT-In: be careful with links in unexpected messages
text: Do not click links in unexpected messages. Check the web address carefully, use official apps or websites, and report phishing to CERT-In.
keywords: link click phishing website domain url download

title: Income Tax Department: check refunds on the official portal
text: The Income Tax Department communicates through its official e-filing portal and registered contacts. Check refund status on the official portal rather than links in messages.
